query: SELECT now()::text AS captured_at,t.id,t.conversation_id,t.location_id,t.owner_text,t.status,t.attempt,t.failure_reason,t.created_at::text,t.claimed_at::text,t.completed_at::text,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t.completed_at-t.created_at)*1000 AS total_latency_ms,o.id AS outbox_id,o.status AS outbox_status,o.attempts AS dispatch_attempts,o.created_at::text AS outbox_created_at,o.dispatched_at::text,o.completed_at::text AS outbox_completed_at FROM agent_turns t LEFT JOIN job_outbox o ON o.topic='agent_turn' AND o.aggregate_id=t.id WHERE t.account_id='019f43d0-0000-7000-8000-000000000001' AND t.created_at>='2026-09-13T21:46:17Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY t.created_at;
